thread:
Maya (Support): SparrowCo reported a sudden throughput collapse + 503s at ~09:12 UTC during their morning burst. They sent logs showing timeouts and ~10% 503s.
Liam (Sales): This is an enterprise pilot with an availability commitment. They're escalating. Looping @Nadia (PM).
Nadia (PM): Maya, paste route/model/payload & region. Is this after any deploy?
Maya (Support): Route: /v1/generate (sparrowco-prod). Model: gpt-xlarge-quant. Avg seq ~600, client concurrency ~140. Attached snippet: `POST /v1/generate {"model":"gpt-xlarge-quant","input":"~500 tokens"} => 503 {"error":"instance overload"}`. They reported regression right after deploy window.
Rohit (Eng): Telemetry shows autoscaler churn + pod restarts in eu-west-1 pool-5 at ~09:10. GPU OOMs and kube OOMKills. We rolled out v2026.07.18.09 which adjusted kernel scheduling heuristics for KV cache. Hypothesis: mem residency spike under high-concurrency.
Ivy (Oncall): Confirmed OOM events and ingress queueing. Several pods restarted; ingress p95 spiked.
deploybot: Rollout v2026.07.18.09 -> pool-5 applied at 2026-07-18T09:05:00Z
Liam (Sales): Customer timeline matches deploy. They want immediate mitigation or rollback. Prefer minimal output drift.
Nadia (PM): Triage options: (A) Per-route fallback to gpt-xlarge-fp16 (low risk, quick). (B) Route to dedicated EU pool (provisioning ~45m). (C) Global rollback of heuristic (~1h, broader impact).
Rohit (Eng): Fallback is fastest and likely resolves mem pressure. We'll need a brief canary to check output quality.
Maya (Support): SparrowCo prefers a config fallback + canary.
Nadia (PM): Decision: implement fallback with 100-request canary (10/90 split) for 15m. Actions: Rohit -> apply override, Ivy -> monitor infra/alerts, Maya -> coordinate with customer, Liam -> update customer comms.
Rohit (Eng): Applying override: `PATCH /v1/routes/sparrowco-prod {"model_override":"gpt-xlarge-fp16","canary_pct":10,"canary_requests":100}`.
Ivy (Oncall): Added temporary alert: `sparrowco_error_rate > 2% for 1m` -> page eng-oncall. Watching node OOMs and ingress.
Maya (Support): Can confirm canary 100 requests: p95 ~310ms, error rate 0.7% (was ~10%). Customer asked for 2-hour stability window after full switch.
Liam (Sales): Communicated fallback and monitoring to customer. They requested RCA + timeline this week.
Nadia (PM): Backlog items and owners:
- P0 RCA (Rohit): reproducible mem spike with heuristic + high concurrency. Due 72h. Acceptance: repro + targeted fix + benchmarks.
- P1 Per-route auto-fallback spec (Nadia): product spec + prototype. Due 2 sprints.
- P1 Runbook update for rollback/mitigations (Ivy): Due 5 days.
- P2 SLA impact calc & comms (Liam): Due 24h.
Rohit (Eng): Created RF-4321. Keeping override for 2h then evaluate. Will add logs and heap dumps to ticket.
deploybot: RF-4321 created by rohit (Eng)
Nadia (PM): Customer resolution criteria:
- p95 < 400ms & error rate < 1% for 2 continuous hours
- RCA delivered and timeline for production fix scheduled
- Per-route mitigation spec added to roadmap
Maya (Support): I'll follow up with SparrowCo in 1 hour.
Ivy (Oncall): If errors exceed 2% escalate to eng-runtime and consider capacity move.
Liam (Sales): Preparing a status email to SparrowCo with next steps and SLA note.
Nadia (PM): Thanks all — treating RCA as P0 and auto-fallback as roadmap outcome. Keep updates here. :white_check_mark:
